title: 第八章  美人计！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林澈看她这反应，心里头门儿清。

这女人嘴硬，打死不承认，也是，六皇子到现在都没碰她的这种丢人事儿说出去，她的面子往哪儿搁？

他干脆利落地站起来，拱了拱手：

“行吧，本来是好心想帮忙，既然你不领情，那告辞。”

说完转身就走，那背影叫一个潇洒。

独孤梦愣住了，眼看着他就要消失在月影里，心里头那股悔意跟开了锅似的往上翻，连忙喊了一声：

“且慢！”

可林澈脚底下跟抹了油似的，眨眼就没了影。

独孤梦咬着嘴唇，手里的酒杯都快攥碎了，心里头七上八下的。

万一林澈真的有招能让六皇子回心转意呢？

但她又转念一想，自己糊涂啊！

他连公主都搞不定，能帮到自己？

算了，自己的事还得自己办，说着又是一杯酒下肚！

再说林澈这边，本就是信口胡来，让这个女人不要去找公主告状，刚才的话纯粹是扰乱她的心智。

自己这边还一堆糟心事，怎么有时间去管别人恩不恩爱。

他摸了摸怀里那本登记名册，不由得安心不少！

登记名册上面清清楚楚地写着：

丫鬟秋菊，申时二刻出府采买，酉时三刻回府。

而林澈被指控“私通”的时间，恰好是酉时左右。

也就是说，秋菊当时就在府里，怎么可能与他在庙会偷情？

自证清白的证据，到手了。

当他志得已满要回自己卧房之时，就看见月璇玑双手交叉抱在胸前，跟个门神似的杵在大厅里。

这女人今晚穿了身素净的衣裳，但架不住身段好，往那儿一站，满屋子都亮堂了三分。

看见林澈进来，她上下打量了一遍，目光在那身特意拾掇过的打扮上停了一瞬，心里头嘀咕了一句：

“打扮得还挺像那么回事，该不会又偷跑出去找女人了吧？”

不过这念头刚冒出来就被她自己掐灭了。

谁会看得上他？

再说了，自己堂堂大夏艳甲在府里，他还看得上别的女人？

放眼整个京城，年轻一辈的女子里头，也就他闺蜜独孤梦能跟她掰掰手腕。

随即她一拍脑袋，我在想什么？

她去偷情那不是正好，说着便想到一个好办法...

一个一劳永逸的办法！

林澈本就心虚，找证据被人抓了个现行，只能支支吾吾道；

“我看今夜月色好出去转转！”

“这总不犯错吧？”

月璇玑本就对林澈顶撞他有气，大晚上就是来找林澈晦气的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Seeing her reaction, Lin Che felt very clear in her heart.

This woman is stubborn and refuses to admit it. Also, the sixth prince has not touched her until now and tells such embarrassing things. Where can she put her face?

He stood up neatly and cupped his hands:

"Okay, I had good intentions and wanted to help. Since you don't appreciate it, then say goodbye."

After saying that, he turned around and left, his back looking cool and unrestrained.

Dugumeng was stunned. Seeing that he was about to disappear in the moonlight, the regret in his heart boiled up like a boiling pot, and he shouted quickly:

"Wait!"

But Lin Che's feet felt as if they were oiled, and they disappeared in the blink of an eye.

Dugumeng bit her lip, the wine glass in her hand almost shattered, and her heart was agitated.

What if Lin Che really had a trick to change the Sixth Prince's mind?

But then she thought again, she was confused!

He can't even handle the princess, how can he help him?

Forget it, you have to take care of your own affairs, so I drank another glass of wine!

Besides, Lin Che was just talking nonsense, telling this woman not to go to the princess to complain. What she just said was just to mess with her mind.

I still have a lot of troubles to worry about, so how can I have time to care about whether others are loving or not?

He touched the registration book in his arms and couldn't help but feel relieved!

The registration list clearly states:

The maid Qiu Ju went out to do some shopping at two o'clock in Shenshi and returned home at three o'clock in Youshi.

The time when Lin Che was accused of "fornication" happened to be around Youshi.

In other words, Qiu Ju was in the house at that time, how could she have an affair with him at the temple fair?

The evidence to prove his innocence is in hand.

When he was satisfied and wanted to go back to his bedroom, he saw Yue Xuanji with her arms crossed in front of her chest, standing in the hall like a door god.

This woman wore plain clothes tonight, but she couldn't help but have a good figure. When she stood there, the whole room became brighter.

Seeing Lin Che come in, she looked her up and down, her eyes paused for a moment on the specially arranged outfit, and she murmured in her heart:

"You're dressed like that. Could you be sneaking out to find a woman again?"

But as soon as the idea came up, she killed it herself.

Who would like him?

Besides, with his own noble Xia Yanjia in the house, can he still like other women?

Looking at the entire capital, among the younger generation of women, only his best friend Dugu Meng could compete with her.

Then she slapped her head, "What am I thinking?"

Isn't it just right for her to have an affair? As she said this, she thought of a good idea...

A once and for all solution!

Lin Che had a guilty conscience, but when she was caught looking for evidence, she could only hesitate;

"I think the moonlight tonight makes it nice to go out and take a walk!"

"It's not a mistake, right?"

Yue Xuanji was already angry with Lin Che for contradicting him, so she came to bring trouble to Lin Che late at night.
